FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 120
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 120 as introduced could reduce state or state-administered federal funding provided
to state and local law enforcement agencies, by an undetermined amount, for failure to adopt a
vehicular pursuit policy pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
